title: God's Full Armor
intro: Paul uses the image of a Roman soldier's armor to describe how Christians can stand against the powers of evil.

items.title: The Belt of Truth
items.text: Bind truth around your waist like a belt. Truth gives stability and holds everything in place.

items.title: The Breastplate of Righteousness
items.text: Put on righteousness as a breastplate. It protects the heart from accusations.

items.title: The Gospel of Peace as Footwear
items.text: Have as shoes on your feet the readiness that the gospel of peace provides.

items.title: The Shield of Faith
items.text: Take up above all the shield of faith, which can extinguish all the evil one's flaming arrows.

items.title: The Helmet of Salvation
items.text: Receive the helmet of salvation. It protects the mind and gives hope.

items.title: The Sword of the Spirit
items.text: Take the sword of the Spirit, which is God's word. The only offensive weapon in the armor.
